    get impl() {
        return window.localStorage;
    }
    get prefix() {
        return this.group === 'NativeStorage' ? '' : `${this.group}.`;
    }
    rawKeys() {
        return Object.keys(this.impl).filter((k) => k.indexOf(this.prefix) === 0);
    }
    applyPrefix(key) {
        return this.prefix + key;
